name: Track access review exceptions to verified closure
description: Give every entitlement flagged during an access review a tracked work item with an owner and a due date, and close it only once the change is confirmed in the underlying system rather than in the ticket.
responsible_role: IAM function, with system owners accountable for closure

steps.action: Require a per-entitlement decision in the review, replacing bulk sign-off.
Auto-create a tracked work item for every retain-with-change or revoke decision, with an owner and due date.
Define closure as system-confirmed: the entitlement change must be observed in the target system before the item is closed.
Reconcile the post-review entitlement export against the flagged items and retain the reconciliation as part of the review record.
Block review sign-off until all flagged items are closed or explicitly re-decided with a recorded rationale.
Schedule reviews against the cadence stated in policy, and align policy to the cadence actually sustainable.

implementation_considerations: Blocking sign-off until closure changes reviewer behaviour more than any amount of guidance; expect initial friction.
System-side confirmation requires a second export after changes are applied. Build that into the cycle rather than treating it as an extra task.
typical_duration: One review cycle to implement, one further cycle to demonstrate.
prerequisites: A ticketing system already used as a system of record
Ability to re-export entitlements after changes are applied

verification_method.how: For a completed review cycle, confirm every flagged item has a work item, a closure record, and a post-change entitlement export showing the change took effect.

residual_risk_note: Closure verification is only as good as the export it is verified against; if the export is incomplete, verified closure over an incomplete population still leaves exposure. Pair with REM-ACCESS-003.
period_limitation_note: Reviews missed or left unclosed during an elapsed period cannot be performed retroactively. A review conducted during fieldwork does not evidence operation during the period.
notes: Backfilled with responsible_role and implementation_considerations in the CC6 phase (schema 0.2.0).
